title: Administrator - GAP Claims Assessment
description:
Administrator GAP Claims Assessment

Salary: £26,450 per annum + Excellent Benefits
Location: Warwick
Working Pattern: Hybrid 1 day working from home
Hours: Monday Friday, 8:30am 5:00pm (37.5 hours)

We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established insurance solutions provider that partners with many of the UK's leading automotive dealer groups to provide GAP insurance.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Administrator, Customer Service Advisor or Claims Handler looking to develop a long-term career within the insurance industry. Full training will be provided, making this an opportunity for someone with strong administration and customer service skills.

The Role of Administrator GAP Claims Assessment

As an Administrator GAP Claims Assessment, you will manage your own portfolio of GAP insurance claims, supporting customers throughout the claims process and ensuring each claim is handled efficiently, accurately and professionally.

You will be responsible for reviewing documentation, researching vehicle values, liaising with motor insurers and keeping customers informed at every stage.
- Manage your own portfolio of GAP insurance claims from start to finish
- Research the current value of customers vehicles and negotiate with motor insurers
- Speak with customers to explain the claims process and provide regular updates
- Review and validate documentation to ensure claims are processed accurately
- Maintain accurate records using internal systems
- Work closely with colleagues to ensure claims are resolved efficiently
- Deliver a professional, empathetic and reassuring service to customers

The ideal candidate for an Administrator GAP Claims Assessment will have:
- Previous experience in administration, customer service or claims handling
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational abilities
- The ability to research information and make informed decisions
- A proactive approach and the ability to manage your own workload
- Confidence using Microsoft Office and CRM systems
- A genuine desire to help customers and deliver excellent service

Insurance, automotive or motor claims experience would be advantageous but is not essential, as full training will be provided.

Benefits
- £26,450 per annum
- Monday Friday working hours no shifts or weekends
- Hybrid working 1 day from home
- Full training, ongoing development and genuine career progression
- BUPA healthcare
- Life insurance and critical illness cover
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Staff discounts and regular company social events
- Modern offices with free on-site parking
- Excellent transport links, close to the A46, Warwick town centre and within walking distance of Warwick Parkway Station

Apply Now

If you have strong administration or customer service experience and are looking for a stable, rewarding role with excellent training and career progression this could be your next move.

title: Business Administrator
company: The Cinnamon Care Collection - Company - Permanent
description:
Business Administrator
£31,000 per annum plus company benefits
Full Time Hours

A Top 20 Care Home Group 2026!

Awarded One of the UK s Best Companies to Work For

Please note, we are unable to offer sponsorship for this role

Oakley Grange is a luxurious residential and dementia care home based in Warwick offering state-of-the-art facilities, which include 66 large en-suite bedrooms and 5 luxury care suites. The home also features luxurious lounges and dining rooms, an on-site café bar, a cinema and a professional hair and beauty salon.

We are looking to recruit an experienced Business Administrator with competent finance skills to join our team. You will be responsible for providing administrative and accounting/credit control support to the home and have direct management of the Admin Assistants/Receptionists

A major part of the Administrator's role is to ensure all client files and accounts are prepared, issued, updated and maintained in line with company policy and regulatory and statutory requirements. You will promote timely payment of client accounts and be proactive in the follow up of outstanding debt to the company in line with the credit control policy.

A knowledge of accounts systems is essential as you will liaise with the Payroll Department; prepare reports and process staff information as per company timescales following verification, input and reconciliation of staff hours worked. Ideally experience in sales and purchase, petty cash and bank reconciliation.

You will also prepare detailed staffing and payroll reports as required for the General Manager and Support staff. Included in your role is to maintain staff records in the staff hours system, the recruitment of staff, creating new employee files, maintaining staff files and recording staff sickness, holidays and leavers.

You will need to have excellent IT skills and knowledge of Excel and be confident in using various internal IT systems and processes.

Our team member benefits include: Paid Breaks Uniforms Staff Meals Nest Pension Employee Assistance Programme Care Workers Charity Spice of Life Discount Retail Scheme Cycle Scheme Eye Care Refer a Friend Scheme Reward Vouchers Quarterly & Annual Company Recognition Awards

title: HR Assistant
description:
This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive and friendly HR consultancy team based in Warwick, providing high-quality administrative support across a varied client base. The role would suit a highly organised, detail-focused administrator who enjoys working in a busy, people-focused environment and is keen to build a long-term career in HR. Previous HR experience would be beneficial but is not essential, as full support, training and exposure to a wide range of HR matters will be provided.

Why Join Us

You will be joining a collaborative team where no two days are the same, gaining hands-on experience across employee relations, recruitment administration, HR documentation, client systems and general HR support. The role offers the chance to learn from experienced HR professionals, attend meetings alongside HR Advisors and develop practical HR knowledge while contributing to meaningful work for clients.

Training and Progression: Training and support will be provided, with the opportunity to develop HR knowledge and progress within the role.

Job Purpose

The role of the job is to provide excellent administrative support to the HR Advice team, helping to deliver a responsive, accurate and professional service to clients while developing practical HR knowledge and experience.

Main Duties
- Drafting HR letters as directed by the team including, disciplinary invites, grievance invites, outcome letters, letters of concern, resignation letters, flexible working letters etc.
- Drafting contracts and offer letters.
- Providing an effective service for our clients.
- Attending meetings with a HR Advisor to develop knowledge and experience.
- Answering incoming calls, taking details and supporting the clients where able to or providing accurate messages to the team in a timely manner.
- Support recruitment campaigns for clients, including drafting job adverts, shortlisting candidates and arranging interviews
- Uploading advice to the CRM system
- Liaising with third party providers e.g. occupational health, DBS
- Supporting the team with administration in relation to clients HR systems
- Note taking during meetings and note typing of meetings and recordings
- Supporting the team with creation and updating of handbooks, policies and contacts for clients

Qualifications and Experience Required for This Role

We are particularly interested in hearing from strong administrators who are highly organised, accurate and keen to develop a career within HR. HR experience would be advantageous, but it is not essential for the right person.
- Outstanding business organisational skills
- HR experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Strong administrator
- Self-motivated, able to take initiative and use sound judgment in day-to-day decision making
- Customer-focused with a 'can do' attitude
- Ability to work to tight and often conflicting deadlines in a fast paced working environment
- Ability to work accurately, with meticulous attention to detail
- Able to work with complete discretion and confidentiality at all times
- Expertise of MS Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook)
